logging_semantics.endpoint_alignment: transition t->t+1 commands ctrl[t+1], scores physical state[t+1] against ref[t+1], and exposes ref[t+2] to the next actor observation except for reference-tail clipping
logging_semantics.world_index: stable IndependentMJWPTrainingEnv batch position for this rollout sample; present only in the world-indexed v6 schema
logging_semantics.sampled_action_preclamp: stochastic action sampled from the PPO policy distribution before the official [-1,1] clamp; this is not actor mean mu
logging_semantics.sampled_action_clamped: the same sampled action after the official [-1,1] clamp
logging_semantics.actor_mu: mean of the Gaussian PPO policy distribution used to draw the recorded sample
logging_semantics.actor_sigma: strictly-positive standard deviation (exp(logstd), not variance) of the Gaussian PPO policy distribution used to draw the recorded sample
logging_semantics.reference_ctrl: full residual-action control target at transition t->t+1 before the policy residual and before actuator ctrlrange
logging_semantics.requested_residual: full action-space signed control-target offset after local scale and formal safety clip, before actuator ctrlrange
logging_semantics.effective_residual_after_ctrlrange: full action-space signed control-target offset remaining after the model's enabled actuator ctrlrange clamp; not realized qpos motion
logging_semantics.residual_lost_to_ctrlrange: signed requested minus effective control-target residual
logging_semantics.legacy_v2_applied_residual: historical v2 right_wrist_applied_residual equals requested_residual for its recorded six dimensions; v2 artifacts remain immutable
logging_semantics.actor_distribution_parameters: mu and sigma are passively captured from the same official get_action_values result as the sampled action; no extra actor forward pass is performed
logging_semantics.contact_summary: control-endpoint hand-object finger flags; not substep collision topology
logging_semantics.write_timing: rollout samples are held in memory and written only at the next epoch boundary or after training completes

coverage.cohort_note: world indices 2/3 are ordinary endpoint40 anchors before epoch63 and fixed endpoint60 tail worlds from epoch63 onward

residual_action.provenance: One controlled local repair of the diagnosed normalized-action unit mismatch. The existing +/-0.05 rad safety limit is retained; only the normalized output mapping changes. EgoEngine does not publish this residual scale.

controlled_experiment.reference_endpoint20_state: Bitwise-equal to the CPU endpoint-20 boundary used by the frozen checkpoint validation; serialized artifact bytes may differ while all 362 state entries agree.
